allowed_inputs.scope: Durable declarations, freezes, valid results, closures and exact diagnostics already attributable to V8
Existing strategy feature gates and portfolio daily volume ladder only

unit_002_diagnostic.interpretation: Membership and reallocation greatly reduced aggregate DD but did not make the early loss block economically positive. A successor must address within-component opportunity quality or another independent mechanism, not rescue the closed membership role.

program_5_capital_ladder_structural_chec.judgment: All 741 accepted births in 2024-2025 occur at multiplier 1. Changing the positive-growth ladder threshold or cap cannot alter U002's 2024-H1 sign failure or the historical maximum-DD path. A nearby ladder Unit is structurally outcome-free and not ready.

program_3_and_7_diagnostic.session_judgment: A time gate is almost exactly a component-membership proxy already exhausted by U002, not an independent session mechanism.
program_3_and_7_diagnostic.weekday_judgment: Weekday stressed-profit signs reverse across the six blocks; no weekday is consistently favorable or adverse.
program_3_and_7_diagnostic.prior_signal_relation_judgment: PERSIST and REVERSE stressed-profit signs reverse across blocks; neither supplies an independent stable gate.
program_3_and_7_diagnostic.rc4_warning_judgment: Warning-state signs reverse across blocks; no causal meta policy is ready.

existing_signal_strength_feasibility.uniform_multiple_limitation: At 2x and above the retained surface is dominated by Cross because feature scales differ materially by component. A global raw or normalized multiplier is therefore not the selected design.
existing_signal_strength_feasibility.reason: Each exact-V8 component already logs its own signal feature and native boundary. Component-relative empirical strength quantiles can be frozen from development-period feature distributions without reading outcomes, leaving all five strategies active and only suppressing weaker exact-V8 signal-passed opportunities.

descriptive_strength_split_not_selection.anti_cherry_pick_rule: These descriptive signs establish information value only. They do not authorize preselecting RC61 or Cross. The successor declaration must freeze one complete all-five component-relative bundle before its economic map opens.

program_recompare.name: entry_signal_market_structure
program_recompare.reason: All five existing feature carriers and their native boundaries are exact, sufficiently dense and internal to V8. A monotone component-relative strengthening gate changes code-level admission for already emitted V8 opportunities only. It is independent of U002 membership/weight/state work and can be mapped completely without native Tester use.

program_recompare.name: external_market_event
program_recompare.reason: The scoped V8-only Optimization excludes external selection input, and exact V8/U002 produced no internal external-event carrier.

program_recompare.name: order_time_session
program_recompare.reason: The four observed entry hours alias component identities almost exactly, while weekday and relation signs reverse across blocks. A time rule would repeat U002 membership filtering without independent causal support.

program_recompare.name: position_management_exit
program_recompare.reason: The accepted lifecycle ledger lacks intraposition counterfactual paths needed to evaluate hold/protection/exit changes before broad native Tester expansion, making this lower-readiness under scarce MT5.

program_recompare.name: portfolio_capital_risk
program_recompare.reason: U001 and U002 already completed static allocation, cap, membership, local reallocation and causal state. The remaining visible positive-growth ladder was inactive throughout all 2024-2025 births, including the failed block and historical DD path.

program_recompare.name: diagnostics_causal_meta
program_recompare.reason: Diagnostics explain U002's nonconfirmation, the ladder's structural irrelevance and the instability/confounding of time/relation states. No separate meta action changes a portfolio decision before the ready Program-1 question.

selected_successor_question.question: Can a complete, non-cherry-picked map of component-relative monotone signal-strength gates suppress weaker exact-V8 entries enough to repair early temporal loss and reduce whole DD while preserving whole and recent stressed value?
selected_successor_question.mechanism_independence_from_unit_002: U002 changed whether components were active, their executable weights and post-loss future-birth state. U003 keeps all five exact V8 components and their signal formulas/directions active, but conditionally refuses only weaker already signal-passed births using each component's own existing feature scale.
selected_successor_question.why_not_lab: Every nonneutral setting is at least as strict as the exact-V8 native gate and can only remove an exact-V8 opportunity. It cannot add a symbol, timeframe, signal family, direction or opportunity timestamp.

successor_design_requirements.threshold_construction: Component-relative thresholds must be derived outcome-free from frozen development feature distributions before candidate economics open.

successor_boundary.required_next_action: Commit and push this whole-map recompare, then declare one serial V8-OPT-U003 existing-signal-strength suppression Unit with its complete deep stages frozen before staging inputs.
